## Problem

What problem does this change solve?

## Change

What behavior, interface, documentation, or deployment detail changed?

## Verification

List the commands run and their results.

## Security and Data

- [ ] No secrets, credentials, real prompts, responses, or employee data are included.
- [ ] Authentication, authorization, audit, or migration implications are documented.
- [ ] Unverified or partially verified behavior is identified.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and contains no unrelated edits.
- [ ] Relevant tests were added or updated.
- [ ] Documentation was updated when user-facing behavior changed.
